_comment: #148 Tier 5: the rumor lattice end-to-end -- ARMED relay plays, beat completes, relay RETIRES. Loads thread_lattice_loop_start (the Raskghar handoff: cleared_the_warren banked, raskghar_sealed pending), so Erin's relay-5 talk_pool stage is ARMED and wins her pool (array-order last-match-wins, social.gd). The first Erin interact fires her relay line for real (talk_pool fires before her erin_errand graph, which needs a 2nd interact). Then install_fixture swaps in thread_lattice_retired (raskghar_sealed now banked) and reloads it via the pause-menu Load path (save_migration's proven idiom); the next Erin interact shows her NEUTRAL retirement line -- the relay is gone. Proves the full armed->retire lifecycle the whole lattice depends on. Seed 9 for convention (fixture rng_state governs; no combat). H1 (#148 whole-branch review): LEG B swaps in garden_unlocked (garden_door_unlocked + watch_runner_pointed) and proves the ARMED gate-runner relay OUTRANKS the standing garden signpost -- erin_garden_open was moved to sit immediately BEFORE the thread-relay block, so a later armed relay wins (the assert_event_absent on the garden reveal is the CAN-FAIL sentinel); LEG C swaps in garden_quiet (garden unlocked but the third completed quest is THE WRONG ORDER, so ZERO thread counters are armed) and proves the garden signpost RETURNS when no relay is armed (garden_open wins). Runs at seeds 9 and 7.
